description.text: Start Deck 100 CoroCoro Comic ver., deck number 000 of Start Deck 100, built around Pikachu and Eevee, the pair that came first as the duo most wanted as a deck in CoroCoro Comic's King of Combi dream-deck project of July 2021. All 60 cards are holo, with cards found only in it, some with CoroCoro in their attack names, and it came with a playmat, a coin, damage counters and markers and a player's guide. It was sold through a code in the February 2022 issue of CoroCoro Comic, out around 15 January 2022, to up to 100,000 readers, and shipped in late March or late August 2022.
